description.value: A full-service highway stop right on the Alaska Highway at Pink Mountain, open year-round with fuel, a general store, coin showers, and laundry — pure utility on a remote northern stretch with no scenic draw.

address.value: Mile 143 Alaska Highway, Pink Mountain, V0C 2B0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully fetched and provides rich service details. Key evidence: the front page lists laundry, coin-operated showers, water station, WiFi, general store with groceries, and 'All Fuels'; the reservations page confirms an online booking form with multiple site types including 'Dry Site'; the contact page confirms the phone number (250) 772-5133. OSM tags corroborate tent and caravan camping with fee. No phone was present in OSM so contact_confirmed.phone is null.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number; phone (250) 772-5133 sourced from website only.
Website address shows only 'Pink Mountain, British Columbia' without the Mile 143 street detail, so full address match against OSM could not be confirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, open year-round campground on the Alaska Highway with confirmed tent camping and a wide range of cyclist-relevant services; a clear asset for anyone riding this remote northern corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: The website lists 'All Fuels' which on the Alaska Highway typically means vehicle fuels (gasoline/diesel); camping-specific fuel (propane, white gas) is not confirmed and has been left null.

wow_evidence: laundry, coin-operated showers, water station, WiFi, general store with groceries
